result.detail: The head of communications is in transit until tomorrow. Request queued; no sign-off received.

args.note: Journalist requested confirmation of the product delay. Per policy, external messages require sign-off from the head of communications before sending. Requested approval for the confirmation message, but the head of communications is in transit until tomorrow and the request remains pending (not approved). No message was sent to the press, since pending approval does not constitute authorization to send. Awaiting sign-off before the confirmation can be delivered.
